fundamentals.name: Lennar Corporation
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Lennar Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a homebuilder primarily under the Lennar brand in the United States. It operates through Homebuilding East, Homebuilding Central, Homebuilding South Central, Homebuilding West, Financial Services, Multifamily, and Lennar Other segments. The company's homebuilding operations include the construction and sale of single-family attached and detached homes, as well as the purchase, development, and sale of residential land; and development, construction, and management of multifamily rental properties. It also offers residential mortgage financing, title insurance, and closing services for home buyers and others, as well as originating and selling securitization commercial mortgage loans. In addition, the company is involved in fund investment activities. It primarily serves first-time, move-up, active adult, and luxury homebuyers. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Miami, Florida.

judgment.summary: A homebuilder with a solid balance sheet and dividend, but facing headwinds in revenue and earnings growth.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates with EPS of $1.31 vs $1.23; next earnings date is 2026-06-11.
positives: Price/Book 1.02 — trading at a reasonable valuation relative to assets.
Total cash $8.88B and current ratio 12.48 — strong liquidity and balance sheet.
Dividend yield 2.1% with a conservative payout ratio of 31.4%.
Forward P/E 12.25x is lower than trailing P/E of 14.20x.
negatives: Revenue growth -5.2% YoY and earnings growth -31.5% YoY indicate a challenging market.
Analyst growth estimates for current Q and FY are negative (-13.9% and -26.7% respectively).
Operating margin of 5.5% and profit margin of 4.9% are modest.
Debt/Equity ratio of 18.60 is high, though offset by significant cash reserves.

news.paragraph: Lennar reported mixed Q2 results, missing earnings expectations despite positive commentary on lower incentives and consumer sentiment from an analyst. The company's revenue and earnings saw year-over-year declines, and a new investor presentation was also released. The housing market challenges continue to be a persistent theme for the homebuilder.
